items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: this guy give me my first break... I feel better in Chick's band than I do in Duke's band... I come here, you know, with Duke Ellington... they listen to me play... the job is yours.

ctx.x: Yeah. The first guy that started writing for Goodman was Jimmy Mundy. He got some of their -- Fletcher and some of the Horace Henderson, I bet, finally made Henderson this band just write complete right to play for him. That was his idea. He wanted band like Henderson band, and he succeeded to have a hell of a -- he developed the best white jazz guys band in that era, but nothing (inaudible).

So they got so popular and so big with the Savoy Ballroom arrangement a battle of music - (unintelligible) Chick Webb and Benny Goodman. The biggest event of music has happened in the city of New York, up to moment opened that (unintelligible).

items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Chick Webb Cheat-Wook (phonetic) was working there all the time, in and out, in and out, in and out. So he used to listen to me.

ctx.x: Was this a kind of an opening band (inaudible)?

It was one of those second-rate bands. They used them at the Savoy as a (inaudible) band, you know, so that chance to develop my playing and got better experience with the jazz and listen all these good men they used to play in there, those bass. You know what I mean? So I'm ready for everybody. So I practiced with that band around six or seven months. Chick Webb Cheat-Wook (phonetic) was working there all the time, in and out, in and out, in and out. So he used to listen to me. I don't have no idea I'm ever…
it don't cost you nothing to go. In fact the man told me to tell you to go. So I said, all right, I'm going, sure.
